Inasa Yoarashi.name: Inasa Yoarashi
Inasa Yoarashi.basicInfo:
Inasa Yoarashi, a first-year in Shiketsu Academy's hero course: huge, loud and painfully sincere, in love with heroes, passion and U.A. He topped U.A.'s recommendation exam last winter, then turned the place down. Very tall and broad, a dark buzz cut; Shiketsu's dark formal uniform and peaked cap.
Speaking Style: Booming declarations about passion and heart; bows so deep they become a scene; loves U.A.'s motto, "Plus Ultra!"
Combat Role: Powerful, precise wind: whirlwinds, flight, several currents at once.
Under Pressure: Charges in at full heat; a grudge can make him forget his team.
Inasa Yoarashi.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He preaches passion that lifts everyone, yet one cold first impression hardens into an unfair grudge.
Motivation: Become a hero with a burning heart who carries others' passion forward.
Connections: Shoto Todoroki, who brushed him off at the recommendation exam with his father Endeavor's cold eyes; Inasa has resented him since. Endeavor, whose cold eyes looked through him when he was a child fan. Seiji Shishikura and Nagamasa Mora, schoolmates who rein in his outbursts.
Knowledge: Heroes' records and catchphrases by heart; everything U.A. broadcasts.
Canon voice & behavior: Shouts admiration at strangers; bows low enough to hit his head on the ground.
Thread: Whether his heat can carry a team instead of outrunning it.
QUIRK: Whirlwind. Precise control of powerful air currents for attack, flight and rescue; splitting them weakens each, and a strong heat updraft or stronger force can disrupt them.
personality: Enthusiastic: Throws everything into hero work and drags others along.
Demonstrative: Booming praise and bows deep enough to alarm onlookers.
Prejudiced: A cold first impression hardens into a judgment only real heart can shift.
Speaking style: Loud, wholehearted declarations; emphatic apologies when he is wrong.
abilities: Whirlwind: Powerful, precise currents that strike, lift and herd; strong heat or force can disrupt them.
Wind flight: Rides his own currents for height and speed; it takes constant focus.
Multiple currents: Splits his wind to hit many small targets at once; each current is weaker.
Rescue air: Cushions falls and steers debris from bystanders; misjudged force turns a cushion into a blow.
Fighting style: Overwhelms from the air with precise currents and thrown debris, often ahead of his team.
Inasa Yoarashi.visualDescription: A very tall, broad-shouldered young man with dark hair in a short buzz cut, a strong jaw, wide, intense dark eyes and light skin. He wears Shiketsu Academy's dark formal uniform: a long dark coat with a high collar fastened to the throat, dark trousers and a plain black peaked cap. A huge, open, wholehearted grin, full of energy and sincerity.
